column3: Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “like” (“like doves”), and “she-goats” is rendered “goats.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “newly,” and “one deprived of offspring” is rendered “has lost her young.”
Close to the Hebrew; The singular “your temple” is rendered “Your temples.”
“Built for layers” (a word of uncertain meaning) is rendered “Built with rows of stones,” and “shields” as “round shields.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Graze” is rendered “feed.”
“Until the day breathes” is rendered “Until the cool of the day,” and NASB adds “my way.”
Close to the Hebrew; “With me from Lebanon … you will come” is rendered “Come with me … May you come,” and “you will come down” as “Journey down.”
“You have stolen my heart” is rendered “You have made my heart beat faster,” and “with one of your eyes” as “with a single glance of your eyes.”
Close to the Hebrew; The plural “loves” is rendered “love,” and NASB adds “kinds of.”
“A spring locked” is rendered “A rock garden locked,” reading “garden” as some manuscripts do.
Close to the Hebrew; “Garden” (pardes) is rendered “orchard.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “You are,” “living water” is rendered “fresh water,” and NASB adds “streams.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “out fragrance,” and “let its spices flow” is rendered “Let its spices be wafted abroad.”
